d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest focused Housekeeping professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As a Housekeeping Attendant you are responsible for daily assigned duties as instructed by Supervisors while adhering to hotel policies and procedures.
q: You should ideally have a vocational training within the Housekeeping Department of a hotel. Good command of English is an advantage.

The ideal candidate will be a friendly, caring, dedicated individual with good cross cultural sensitivity and the willingness to put in an extra effort and time when required, as well as the passion to serve customers.
You will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment and enjoy working with a multicultural team and guests alike, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: li
Receive work assignment, keys and supplies from the supervisor and sign the key log book accurately
li
Clean rooms and bathrooms, performing any combination of the following duties
li
Keep fire exits and stair ways clear of any obstruction
li
Check and report any maintenance work required immediately
li
Pick up any litter from corridors and pathways
li
Vacuum carpet and upholstered furniture, dust and wipe furniture, empty ashtrays and wastebaskets
li
Make bed, wash sink, bathtub, toilet, tiles, mirrors and floor and polish brass and metal
li
Replenish bathroom supplies and room supplies
li
Tidy and arrange neatly guest toilet articles on vanity top and spot cleans carpet when necessary
li
Clean and keep the guest corridors, service pantries and service areas neat and tidy at all times
li
Remove Room Service tray and trolley from guestroom and corridors
li
Inform valet service to collect guests clothes for laundry, dry cleaning or pressing services

d: Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
Sulzer is looking for an experienced Machinist to join our Service Centre team in Bahrain.

Sulzer is looking for an experienced Machinist to join our Service Centre team in Bahrain. This role is ideal for a hands-on machinist with strong manual lathe experience, a solid understanding of machine shop practices, and the ability to manufacture and repair components to tight tolerances.
You will be responsible for completing machining activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards while supporting the repair and refurbishment of critical equipment.
Set up and operate manual lathes and other machine shop equipment.
Machine components to engineering drawings and required tolerances.
Carry out turning, facing, boring, threading, and general lathe operations.
Complete assigned machining work safely, accurately, and on schedule.
Inspect completed work and identify dimensional or drawing discrepancies.
Maintain route cards, job documentation, and production records.
Ensure all tools and equipment are used correctly and maintained appropriately.
Support Lean, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
Liaise with Engineering, Inspection, Projects, and QESH teams as required.
Apprentice trained or equivalent machining qualification.
Proven experience working as a Machinist within a machine shop or workshop environment.
Strong hands-on experience operating manual lathes is essential.
Experience with turning, boring, threading, shaft machining, and precision machining operations.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings.
Knowledge of machining tolerances, measuring equipment, and workshop best practices.
Understanding of health and safety requirements within a machine shop environment.
Good attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Ability to work independently and manage workload effectively.
q: Experience machining shafts, sleeves, bearing housings, and other precision components.
Exposure to CNC lathes or milling machines would be advantageous.
Experience in repair and refurbishment work within a service centre environment is beneficial.
Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
